issues.title: Order confirmation email not received
issues.problem_statement: The customer had connected their payment gateway, but their customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they buy.

issues.title: Default sender name on the email
issues.problem_statement: The order confirmation email still shows the default sender name, and the customer wants to use their brand name.

items.description: Customer switched on the order confirmation email for the product and saved it, following support's guidance, and after placing a test order confirmed the confirmation email arrived in their inbox.
evidence: the confirmation email just arrived in my inbox!

items.description: Support explained that the email still shows the default sender name and that it can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.
evidence: the email still shows the default sender name
You can change it under Email settings, Sender name.

items.description: Customer will change the sender name under Email settings to their brand name.
evidence: I'll change that myself after the call, I want to use my brand name.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
